summary: Remediated rsyslog drift on node1-node4. All nodes now accept TCP local0 syslog on port 5514, write to /var/log/infraset-app.log, enforce the required SELinux/firewall controls, and run rsyslog enabled. Application databases remained unchanged. Every node passed a serial restart-persistence test.
actions_performed: Corrected node1 from TCP/5515 to TCP/5514 and repaired its log-file SELinux context.
Added persistent and runtime firewalld access for TCP/5514.
Mapped TCP/5514 to syslogd_port_t under enforcing SELinux.
Enabled and started rsyslog on every node.
Verified package integrity, configuration syntax, listeners, and actual TCP local0 delivery.
Restarted each node individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.
